notes: Godot 4.0 tower defense for Godot Wild Jam #60 (theme: Malfunction). Five towers with unique attack and malfunction behaviour, three waves, buy/upgrade UI. Upstream HTML5 export under docs/ (index.wasm, index.pck, and companion web files) is omitted from this snapshot. No bundled fonts or audio. icon.svg is an original ochre-tower-and-turret mark (md5 628bf39967d8b98da6b2523186e41674), replacing the Godot default project icon. Review fix: unattributed professional goblin sprites (Photoshop XMP 2019–2020, years before the jam) and the 4027×4027 stock-style money_icon.png are replaced with original flat marks (Goblins1.md5 9dd82907497cc37fb48f9bc4618baab2; Goblins2.md5 28a5ffebbd87019dfea7e561a610c667; money_icon.md5 32c8491a648c47b76e3230e9e015f11c). Jam-period hand-drawn tiles, towers, fuel-can, and wave-bubble textures are kept. No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp.
